title: POT: Inducing Overthinking in LLMs via Black-Box Iterative Optimization
authors: Xinyu Li; Tianjin Huang; Ronghui Mu; Xiaowei Huang; Gaojie Jin
why_relevant: Proposes a prompt-only overthinking attack that contrasts with prior RAG-based poisoning overthinking attacks; tangentially related to adversarial attacks on reasoning LLMs.
why_not_or_caveat: The attack itself bypasses RAG and targets prompts, not retrieval pipelines, so it's not centrally about robust RAG.
